item.title: Leadership & Change Leadership
item.description: Leadership in digital transformation requires balancing technical excellence with empathetic change leadership 🚀. The Change Leadership Curve 📈 Every new system creates temporary productivity loss. Understanding these emotional phases is crucial for effective change leadership: The Change Leadership Curve: Productivity temporarily drops during change management before reaching new levels of effectiveness. The Seven Phases of Change Leadership The Challenge of IT Change in Organizations 🎓 Digital transformation in organizations is fundamentally a cultural challenge, not just a technical one.

item.title: Chemie-Lernen.org: My VR Education Project
item.description: Educational Innovation Through Virtual Reality This project represents my personal commitment to transforming education through immersive technology. Chemie-Lernen.org combines my expertise in XR development with educational research to create meaningful learning experiences. My Role and Vision As the creator and lead developer of Chemie-Lernen.org, I envisioned a platform that would: Bridge the gap between abstract chemistry concepts and tangible understanding Democratize access to high-quality science education regardless of location Pioneer web-based VR as an accessible alternative to expensive hardware solutions Contribute to research on the effectiveness of VR in educational settings Technical Implementation Journey Architecture Decisions I chose a stack optimized for accessibility and sustainability:

item.title: Research and Publications
item.description: My research focuses on the intersection of emerging technologies and their impact on digital sovereignty and human-computer interaction 🔬. Core Research Areas 📚: 1. Digital Sovereignty in the Age of AI 🛡️ Exploring the socio-technical implications of large-scale AI models and the necessity of open-source, sovereign infrastructure. Key areas include: Decentralized model training and execution 🖥️. Privacy-preserving data analytics 🔒. Mitigating vendor lock-in in critical infrastructure 🔓. 2. Immersive Educational Environments (XR) 🥽 Investigating the application of eXtended Reality (XR) for learning complex subjects like chemistry and physics.

item.title: Impact of GenAI Sales Agent Timing in VR Commerce
item.description: Research Abstract The Scenario Methodology Findings Research Report Visualization Interference Timing of GenAI Sales Agents in Virtual Reality How does the timing of an AI assistant's approach affect consumer behavior in the Metaverse? This study investigates the impact of Immediate vs. Delayed interference on user experience, decision confidence, and purchase intention. View Results Explore Setup The Experimental Scenario Participants were placed in a Virtual Reality showroom and tasked with choosing a 3D printer.

item.title: My Personal Hubs Instance: A Dedicated XR Space
item.description: I have set up a personal instance of Mozilla Hubs to explore and demonstrate the capabilities of this versatile VR platform 🥽. This dedicated space allows for a more controlled environment to showcase and experiment with features for socializing, collaboration, and immersive experiences 🌌. Key Features and Benefits 🔑: Browser-Native Access: Easily join and interact within 3D environments directly from your web browser, requiring no additional software 🌐. Customizable Presence: Utilize personalized avatars to represent yourself in the virtual space 👤.

item.title: Behavioral Graphs: Enhancing XR Interaction
item.description: Behavioral Graphs (BGs) represent an innovative extension to platforms like Mozilla Hubs, designed to enrich XR environments with interactive features 📊. We believe BGs offer a significant advancement beyond traditional “gallery-like” scenes, pushing the boundaries of user engagement in virtual spaces 🌌. What are Behavioral Graphs? 🧠 Behavioral Graphs are dynamic, data-driven systems that analyze and respond to user actions within XR environments. They enable more personalized and interactive experiences by modeling user behavior and providing context-aware assistance or content 🤖.

item.title: Mozilla Hubs XR Experiments: Enhancing Educational Spaces
item.description: This section details experiments with Mozilla Hubs, exploring its application in university teaching and creating immersive learning environments 🎓. Our goal is to represent complex subjects, like the periodic table, as interactive networks of virtual spaces 🕸️. Project Overview: The Periodic Table in VR 🧪 We are developing virtual environments where each element has its own dedicated space, enriched with relevant information. For example, nitrogen’s space could illustrate the formation of nitrogen oxides in car traffic or its role in fertilizer production 💨.
